About

The pattern behind the roles

Sixteen years in analytics and AI, including nine-plus at Walmart, spent in the seam between what the data says, what engineering can build, and what the customer actually needs. I currently lead a 25+ person organization across four pillars — Self-Serve/Chatbots/AI, CRM, Workforce Management, and Ops — and have shipped alongside Product teams in customer service, fulfillment, facilities, fuel & convenience, and store innovation.

My pattern is consistent: move analytics from reporting what happened to shaping what the business does next. That means building the metric repositories and governance that make enterprise data trustworthy, the experiments that prove what actually works, and increasingly, the AI agents that put certified answers in a leader's hands without a request queue in between.

Equally at home setting three-year data strategy and prototyping the thing that proves it — comfortable with ambiguity, allergic to dashboards nobody acts on.

Experience, by Lens

Four ways to look at the same career

The work overlaps constantly — an AI launch is also a product bet, a data platform is also a business-strategy call. These buckets are just the four lenses people usually ask about.

Agentic AI, GenAI, computer vision, and conversational AI — built to change a decision, not just add a feature. My focus is always the measurement framework underneath: how do we know it worked?

Claude + BigQuery

AISLE1: Putting Certified Metrics in a Conversation

Built an agentic AI insights product that serves as the org's governed metric repository. Leaders query certified definitions in natural language and get narrative answers with context — not just tables — and the semantic layer keeps the number the same no matter who asks. It absorbed the recurring ad hoc analysis load and now powers “4-in-the-box” product, ops, and engineering reviews.

Conversational AI

Sierra Voice AI: Defining What “Good” Looks Like

Owned the measurement framework — containment, resolution, cost per contact — that leadership used to judge the shift from traditional IVR to an AI voice assistant. Self-serve rate rose from 30% to 70%, with CSAT climbing alongside it rather than trading off against it.

AI-based CRM Platform

Agent Assist: From Pilot to Scale

Partnered directly with Product on AI-based voice and chat agents on the CRM platform — requirements and problem framing, pilot design, launch readiness, adoption tracking, and post-launch iteration. Part of a broader CRM AI push that delivered $36M in realized savings.

Intelligent Retail Lab

Computer Vision at the Store of the Future

Directed the data analytics and ML team behind a computer-vision shrink-prevention platform. Behavior and shrink-pattern analysis drove material product improvements, preventing $330M in loss and producing a filed patent (Virtual Cart Optimization Tool).

I build the analytics that decide what gets built — instrumentation, funnels, experiment design, and the success metrics a product is judged on — embedded with Product from problem definition through launch and scale.

Product Analytics

Shipping the Instrumentation Behind the Roadmap

Own product analytics for the full service portfolio — instrumentation, journey funnels, containment and escalation analysis, and self-serve deep dives that tell Product exactly where customers dropped off and which experiences to rebuild first.

Membership Growth

Walmart+ Fuel Benefits: Adoption from Day One

Partnered with the Walmart+ product team to launch a member fuel benefit, building the adoption and redemption tracking that connected fuel behavior to membership growth and retention from the first day of launch.

Facility Services

Tech Assist: Turning Maintenance Reactive to Proactive

Partnered with Product to deploy live refrigeration and HVAC telemetry monitoring, giving field teams a signal before equipment failed — turning a maintenance queue into a proactive product experience.

Decision Systems

Metric Governance as a Product Decision

Established definitions, architecture review, and sign-off processes that gave Product one trusted source of truth for roadmap and prioritization — replacing dashboard sprawl with an actual decision system.

I work at the seam where physical footprint, operating model, cost structure, and customer experience meet — framing the right problems and converting complex operational challenges into scalable capabilities.

0→1 Business Strategy

Building Fuel & Convenience from the Ground Up

Built the strategy and data foundation for a new division from zero, standing up the metrics an entire business needed to operate — and drove a 26% merchandise sales lift by connecting fuel traffic to inside-store purchases.

Network Strategy

Middle-Mile Strategy: Internal Consolidation Centers

Helped shape the build-out and operating case for Internal Consolidation Centers, modeling flow, capacity, and cost-to-serve to inform how volume moved through the network — part of a 35% GMV lift for the fulfillment business.

Executive Communication

One-Page Decision Briefs for 200+ Leaders

Translated network economics — cost to serve, capacity, carrier performance — into a one-page format used every week across Weekly Business Reviews, making complex trade-offs legible fast for a multibillion-dollar business.

Connected Assets

From Reactive Tickets to Proactive Asset Strategy

Built the data and IoT foundation for Facilities Maintenance — architecture, telemetry flows, asset hierarchy — shifting the operating model from ticket response to prevention and informing capital versus expense decisions on repair-or-replace.

Enterprise data only creates value if people trust it and can actually get to it. I build the metric repositories, governance, and self-service layers that make that true at scale.

Enterprise Platform

A 300K+ User Analytics Platform

Owned capacity, row-level security, and self-service enablement for an enterprise analytics platform serving 300,000+ users, and designed a data-lake landscape that shifted the org toward self-service.

Applied NLP

NLP Self-Service at Sam's Club

Shipped natural-language self-service so senior leaders could query their own data in free-form text — then trained them on it, treating adoption as seriously as the technical build.

Causal Impact

Experimentation as a Practice, Not a One-Off

Ran control-group testing and IVR modernization measurement, built AHT trackers, and recovered IEX forecasting accuracy from red to green — turning experimentation into a standing capability rather than a special project.

Diagnostic Analytics

Text Analytics to Find the Root Cause

Used text analytics to diagnose root causes across the bottom 10% of Sam's Club locations and target intervention precisely — grounded by running field inspections as first-hand user research.
